skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Temperature Difference RT.RX07
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Temperature Difference Series Swimming Suit Type RX07. Attached with various accessories for convenient use. The special material is fire and cold-proof, suitable for activities in a variety of waters.
skins.quote: When the sunlight scatters the chill air, the warm breeze thaws the clammy clouds, and even the storm has decided to stop over sea—please, allow her some time to rest.

skins.name: Northern Pathfinder
skins.content: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Northern Pathfinder. Made with special materials with function in mind, perfect for meeting your various needs and weathering even the roughest conditions.
skins.quote: A lone hunter of the wilderness who maintains order for Sami. Her greatest challenge yet: how to explain proper precautions to an enormous combined Scientific Exploration team of nearly a hundred people.
